industry.key: P. Energy, commodities and metals mining
industry.why: Neutral, carried; the condition back to B (industry relative strength returning to B with oil holding) is not met: relative strength C (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior), Brent near $90 (Goldman, Struyven, 22-Nov) from $111 to $115 at the October reads. The sector rows carry the view (Downstream A, Upstream B, Services B) and each is $5 from its $85 trigger, with Goldman's base case ($88 average in 2027, $78 by December 2027) going through it and Kofler (Jefferies, 21-Nov) fearing Iran escalation the other way. 18 Pool names. Back to B if relative strength returns to B with Brent holding above $85.

sector.why: Overweight, carried: Brent near $90 with Iran the two-sided swing (Goldman, 22-Nov; Jefferies, Kofler, 21-Nov); relative strength B (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior). Twelve Pool names (Eni, Equinor, Repsol, TotalEnergies, OMV, DNO, BlueNord, OMV Petrom, Romgaz, Seplat, MOL, Var Energi), the largest sector in the Pool, which is why the sector cap on the Lists (component 5, amendment 6) stays. Counter-case: producers move with crude and the consensus path is lower. Back to C if Brent is read under $85.

geography.why: Overweight, carried; the condition (back to C if Brent is read under $85 or Oslo's leadership reverses for four weeks) is not met: Brent near $90 (Goldman, 22-Nov), Oslo not read, Upstream relative strength B. Counter-case: a country letter resting on one commodity five dollars from its trigger, with the consensus path pointing through it. Back to C if Brent is read under $85.
